_meta.comment: Shared data for the EcoMeter extension and the Legerly pricing page. 'api' = per-token USD (input/output). 'subscriptions' = consumer plan $/month. 'free_tiers' = which models each platform's FREE plan exposes (drives the extension model picker). To update prices, edit the numbers here.
_meta.source: Official provider pricing pages + free-tier availability
_meta.verified: 2026-07-28 against platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing, developers.openai.com pricing, ai.google.dev + cloud.google.com/vertex-ai pricing, docs.x.ai/docs/models, api-docs.deepseek.com, mistral.ai/pricing/api, docs.perplexity.ai

caveats.claude-sonnet-5: $2/$10 per 1M is Anthropic's introductory rate, listed through 2026-08-31. Standard rate is $3/$15 — re-check after that date.
caveats._long_context: 'input'/'output' are the SHORT-CONTEXT rates. Where a provider charges more past a context threshold, the optional 'long' block holds { over, input, output }: 'over' is the INPUT-token count at which the higher rate starts, and that rate then applies to ALL tokens in the request, not just the excess. Thresholds are OpenAI >272k (per the tooltip on developers.openai.com/docs/pricing), Google >200k, xAI >=200k. Anthropic does not tier this way and has no 'long' block. A consumer that ignores 'long' silently undercounts long conversations by roughly 2x — which is the OPPOSITE direction to the unmodelled prompt-caching discount, so the two do not cancel out.
caveats._perplexity_request_fees: Sonar token rates are correct but they are not the whole bill. Perplexity also charges $5-$14 per 1,000 requests depending on model and search-context size. For chat-shaped usage that per-request fee typically exceeds the token cost, so any Perplexity figure derived from this file is a substantial UNDERCOUNT.
caveats._claude_tokenizer: Anthropic states that Claude 4.7 and later (Opus 4.7/4.8/5, Sonnet 5, Fable 5, Mythos 5) use a newer tokenizer producing approximately 30% more tokens for the same text than Sonnet 4.6 and earlier. Identical text is therefore NOT an identical token count across providers or across Claude generations. Any cross-model cost comparison built on a fixed token count understates these models by roughly a third.
caveats._legacy_keys: grok-4 / grok-3 / grok-3-mini, deepseek-v3 / deepseek-r1, mistral-medium-3 / mistral-small-3 and the o1 / gpt-4 / gpt-4-turbo family are no longer listed on their providers' current pricing pages. They are retained at last-known rates because they remain selectable in the extension's model picker; treat those numbers as historical, not current.
caveats.deepseek-reasoner: DeepSeek's API aliases (deepseek-chat, deepseek-reasoner) track whichever model is current rather than a fixed version. Priced here as v4-flash and v4-pro respectively, which is an inference from DeepSeek's current lineup, not a published mapping.

subscriptions.note: No paid consumer tier — chat is free

anthropic.label: Claude
anthropic.note: Free plan: Sonnet 5 default (Sonnet 4.6 still selectable), limited Haiku 4.5. No Opus, Fable, or Mythos.

openai.label: ChatGPT
openai.note: Free plan: GPT-5.5 default, GPT-5.4 mini via Thinking.

google.label: Gemini
google.note: Free app: Gemini 3.5 Flash default, limited daily Gemini 3 Pro.

xai.label: Grok
xai.note: Free serves a capped lighter Grok variant; priced here at flagship Grok 4.3 (upper bound).

mistral.label: Mistral (Le Chat)
mistral.note: Free plan: Medium 3.5 and Small 4, ~25 messages/day.

perplexity.label: Perplexity
perplexity.note: Free plan: default Sonar, plus a ~$5/1k per-request search fee not shown here.

deepseek.label: DeepSeek
deepseek.note: Free web chat exposes the full model line-up (fair-use throttling only).

microsoft.label: Copilot
microsoft.note: Copilot resells OpenAI — free tier runs GPT-5.5.
